\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}init\_elem}}~x~y\)¶

  1. Let \(z\) be the current state.

  2. Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) is on the top of the stack.

  3. Pop the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) from the stack.

  5. Pop the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~j)\) from the stack.

  6. Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) is on the top of the stack.

  7. Pop the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) from the stack.

  8. Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

  9. Pop the value \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) from the stack.

  10. If \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}} = \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}null}}\), then:

    1. Trap.

  11. Assert: Due to validation, \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) is some \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-arrayaddr}{\mathit{arrayaddr}}}\).

  12. Let \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) be the destructuring of \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\).

  13. If \(a < {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{arrays}}|}\) and \(i + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{arrays}}{}[a]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-arrayinst}{\mathsf{fields}}|}\), then:

    1. Trap.

  14. If \(j + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{elems}}{}[y]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-eleminst}{\mathsf{refs}}|}\), then:

    1. Trap.

  15. If \(n = 0\), then:

    1. Do nothing.

  16. Else if \(j < {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{elems}}{}[y]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-eleminst}{\mathsf{refs}}|}\), then:

    1. Let \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathit{ref}}}\) be the reference value \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{elems}}{}[y]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-eleminst}{\mathsf{refs}}{}[j]\).

    2. Push the value \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) to the stack.

    3. Push the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) to the stack.

    4. Push the value \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathit{ref}}}\) to the stack.

    5. Execute the instruction \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}set}}~x)\).

    6. Push the value \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) to the stack.

    7. Push the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i + 1)\) to the stack.

    8. Push the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~j + 1)\) to the stack.

    9. Push the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) to the stack.

    10. Execute the instruction \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}init\_elem}}~x~y)\).

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-extern}{\mathsf{any{.}convert\_extern}}\)¶

  1. Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

Numeric Instructions¶

Numeric instructions are defined in terms of the generic numeric operators. The mapping of numeric instructions to their underlying operators is expressed by the following definition:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(i_1,\dots,i_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#int-ops}{\mathrm{i}\mathit{op}}_N(i_1,\dots,i_k) \\ \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(z_1,\dots,z_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#float-ops}{\mathrm{f}\mathit{op}}_N(z_1,\dots,z_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

And for conversion operators:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-cvtop}{\mathit{cvtop}}^{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-sx}{\mathit{sx}}^?}_{t_1,t_2}(c) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#convert-ops}{\mathit{cvtop}}^{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-sx}{\mathit{sx}}^?}_{|t_1|,|t_2|}(c) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

Where the underlying operators are partial, the corresponding instruction will trap when the result is not defined. Where the underlying operators are non-deterministic, because they may return one of multiple possible NaN values, so are the corresponding instructions.

Note

For example, the result of instruction \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}\) applied to operands \(i_1, i_2\) invokes \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}}(i_1, i_2)\), which maps to the generic \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#op-iadd}{\mathrm{iadd}}_{32}(i_1, i_2)\) via the above definition. Similarly, \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle64}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{trunc}}\mathsf{\_}\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f\scriptstyle32}}\mathsf{\_s}\) applied to \(z\) invokes \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{trunc}}^{\mathsf{s}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f\scriptstyle32}},\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle64}}}(z)\), which maps to the generic \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#op-trunc}{\mathrm{trunc}^{\mathsf{s}}}_{32,64}(z)\).

\(\mathit{nt}\mathsf{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~c\)¶

No formal reduction rule is required for this instruction, since \(\mathsf{const}\) instructions already are values.

Vector Instructions¶

Vector instructions that operate bitwise are handled as integer operations of respective bit width.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-vectype}{\mathsf{v}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(i_1,\dots,i_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#int-ops}{\mathrm{i}\mathit{op}}_N(i_1,\dots,i_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

Most other vector instructions are defined in terms of numeric operators that are applied lane-wise according to the given shape.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{llll} \mathit{op}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1,\dots,n_k) &=& \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(\href{../Step_pure/instructions.html#exec-instr-numeric}{\mathit{op}}_t(i_1,\dots,i_k)^\ast) & \qquad(\mathrel{\mbox{if}} i_1^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1) \land \dots \land i_k^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

Note

For example, the result of instruction \(\mathsf{i32x4}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}\) applied to operands \(v_1, v_2\) invokes \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_1, v_2)\), which maps to \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}}(i_1, i_2)^\ast)\), where \(i_1^\ast\) and \(i_2^\ast\) are sequences resulting from invoking \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_1)\) and \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_2)\) respectively.

For non-deterministic operators this definition is generalized to sets:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll} \mathit{op}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1,\dots,n_k) &=& \{ \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(i^\ast) ~|~ i^\ast \in {\Large\times}(\href{../Step_pure/instructions.html#exec-instr-numeric}{\mathit{op}}_t(i_1,\dots,i_k)^\ast) \land i_1^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1) \land \dots \land i_k^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_k) \} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

where \({\Large\times} \{x^\ast\}^N\) transforms a sequence of \(N\) sets of values into a set of sequences of \(N\) values by computing the set product:

\[\begin{array}{lll} {\Large\times} (S_1 \dots S_N) &=& \{ x_1 \dots x_N ~|~ x_1 \in S_1 \land \dots \land x_N \in S_N \} \end{array}\]

The remaining vector operators use individual definitions.

\(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-vectype}{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}}\mathsf{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-vec}{\mathsf{const}}~c\)¶

  1. Push the value \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-vectype}{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~c)\) to the stack.

Expressions¶

An expression is evaluated relative to a current frame pointing to its containing module instance.

\(\mathsf{eval\_expr}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\)¶

  1. Execute the sequence \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\).

  2. Pop the value \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) from the stack.

  3. Return \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\).

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & z ; {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast} & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow^\ast} & {z'} ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast} & \quad \mbox{if}~ z ; {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast} \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow^\ast} {z'} ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

Note

Evaluation iterates this reduction rule until reaching a value. Expressions constituting function bodies are executed during function invocation.

指令¶

WebAssembly 由执行人进行计算 指令.

参数指令¶

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{nop}}\)¶

  1. 什么都别做。

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & \href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{nop}} & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & \epsilon \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{unreachable}}\)¶

  1. 陷阱.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & \href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{unreachable}} & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-trap}{\mathsf{trap}} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-parametric}{\mathsf{drop}}\)¶

  1. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  2. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 从 栈.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}~\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-parametric}{\mathsf{drop}} & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & \epsilon \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-parametric}{\mathsf{select}}~{({t^\ast})^?}\)¶

  1. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  2. 弹出值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~c)\) 从 栈.

  3. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  4. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_2\) 从 栈.

  5. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  6. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_1\) 从 栈.

  7. 若为 \(c \neq 0\),则:

    1. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_1\) 页:1 栈.

  8. 否则:

    1. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_2\) 页:1 栈.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_1~{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_2~(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~c)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-parametric}{\mathsf{select}}~{({t^\ast})^?}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_1 & \quad \mbox{if}~ c \neq 0 \\ & {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_1~{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_2~(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~c)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-parametric}{\mathsf{select}}~{({t^\ast})^?}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}_2 & \quad \mbox{if}~ c = 0 \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

说明

未来版本 WebAssembly, \(\mathsf{select}\) 每个选择可能允许一个以上的数值。

控制指令¶

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{block}}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 让 \({t_1^{m}}~{\mathrel{\href{../valid/conventions.html#syntax-instrtype}{\rightarrow}}}_{{{\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-localidx}{\mathit{localidx}}}_0^\ast}}\,{t_2^{n}}\) 被调整结构 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-blocktype}{\mathrm{instrtype}}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}})\).

  3. 表示: 应付 验证, \({{\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-localidx}{\mathit{localidx}}}_0^\ast} = \epsilon\).

  4. 表示: 应付 验证,至少还有 \(m\) 值 在顶部 栈.

  5. 弹出 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}\) 从 栈.

  6. 让 \(L\) 成为 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 他们的分量是: \(n\) 并且它的延续是 街区的结束。

  7. 输入块 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\) 与 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) \(L\).

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & z ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{block}}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{n}}{\{ \epsilon \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \quad \mbox{if}~ {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-blocktype}{\mathrm{instrtype}}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}}) = {t_1^{m}} \rightarrow {t_2^{n}} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l\)¶

  1. 如果第一个非价值输入 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\),则:

    1. 让 \(L\) 成为顶级 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\).

    2. 让 \(n\) 成为 \(L\)

    3. 若为 \(l = 0\),则:

      1. 表示: 应付 验证,至少还有 \(n\) 值 在顶部 栈.

      2. 弹出 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}\) 从 栈.

      3. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

      4. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 从 栈.

      5. 推开 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}\) 页:1 栈.

      6. 跳转到继续 \(L\).

    4. 否则:

      1. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

      2. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 从 栈.

      3. 推开 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 页:1 栈.

      4. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l - 1)\).

  2. 否则:

    1. 表示: 应付 验证,第一个非价值条目 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\).

    2. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

    3. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\) 从 栈.

    4. 推开 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 页:1 栈.

    5. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l)\).

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{n}}{\{ {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}'}^\ast} \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}^\ast}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l)~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}'}^\ast} & \quad \mbox{if}~ l = 0 \\ & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{n}}{\{ {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}'}^\ast} \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l)~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l - 1) & \quad \mbox{if}~ l > 0 \\ & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}}_{n}}{\{ {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}^\ast} \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l)~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{br}}~l) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{return}}\)¶

  1. 如果第一个非价值输入 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}\),则:

    1. 让 \(f\) 成为顶级 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}\).

    6. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}\) 从 栈.

    7. 推开 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}\) 页:1 栈.

    1. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

    2. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 从 栈.

    3. 推开 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 页:1 栈.

    4. 执行 指令 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{return}}\).

  3. 否则:

    1. 表示: 应付 验证,第一个非价值条目 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\).

    2. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

    3. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\) 从 栈.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{throw\_ref}}\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}\) 从 栈.

  4. 若为 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'} = \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}null}}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

  5. 若为 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}\) 有点 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-exnaddr}{\mathit{exnaddr}}}\),则:

    1. 让 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~a)\) 被调整结构 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}\).

    2. 弹 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}\) 从顶部 栈.

    3. 若为 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast} \neq \epsilon\),则:

      1. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

      2. 执行 指令 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{throw\_ref}}\).

    4. 如果第一个非值输入 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\),则:

      1. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 从 栈.

      2. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

      3. 执行 指令 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{throw\_ref}}\).

    5. 否则:

      1. 如果第一个非价值输入 栈 是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}\),则:

        1. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}\) 从 栈.

        2. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

        3. 执行 指令 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{throw\_ref}}\).

      2. 如果第一个非值输入 栈 不是一个 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\),则:

        1. 抛出例外 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}\) 由此而来。

      3. 否则:

        1. 让 \(H\) 成为顶级 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\).

        2. 让 \(n\) 成为 \(H\)

        3. 让 \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}''}^\ast}\) 成为捕捉者 \(H\)

        4. 若为 \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}''}^\ast} = \epsilon\),则:

          1. 弹出 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\) 从 栈.

          2. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}exn}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

          3. 执行 指令 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{throw\_ref}}\).

        5. 否则,如果 \(a \geq {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{exns}}|}\),则:

          1. 让 \({\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}_0~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}'}^\ast}\) 为: \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}''}^\ast}\).

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{try\_table}}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}^\ast}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 让 \({t_1^{m}}~{\mathrel{\href{../valid/conventions.html#syntax-instrtype}{\rightarrow}}}_{{{\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-localidx}{\mathit{localidx}}}_0^\ast}}\,{t_2^{n}}\) 被调整结构 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-blocktype}{\mathrm{instrtype}}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}})\).

  3. 表示: 应付 验证, \({{\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-localidx}{\mathit{localidx}}}_0^\ast} = \epsilon\).

  4. 表示: 应付 验证,至少还有 \(m\) 值 在顶部 栈.

  5. 弹出 值 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}\) 从 栈.

  6. 让 \(H\) 成为 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\) 他们的分量是: \(n\) 他们的捕捉者, \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}^\ast}\).

  7. 推开 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}\) \(H\).

  8. 让 \(L\) 成为 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) 他们的分量是: \(n\) 并且它的延续是 街区的结束。

  9. 输入块 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}\) 与 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}\) \(L\).

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & z ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{try\_table}}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}^\ast}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-handler}{\mathsf{handler}}}_{n}}{\{ {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-catch}{\mathit{catch}}}^\ast} \}}~({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{n}}{\{ \epsilon \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{m}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast})) & \\ &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad \quad \mbox{if}~ {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-blocktype}{\mathrm{instrtype}}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}}) = {t_1^{m}} \rightarrow {t_2^{n}} } \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

块¶

以下辅助规则定义了执行一个 指令 顺序 构成一个 块.

输入 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\) 与 标签 \(L\) 和 值 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^\ast\)¶

  1. 推开 \(L\) 页:1 栈.

  2. 推开 值 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^\ast\) 页:1 栈.

  3. 跳转到开始 指令 顺序 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\).

说明

加入一项条约不需要正式的削减规则。 指令 顺序, 因为 标签 \(L\) 嵌入到 管理指令 结构化 控制指令 减为直接。

退出 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\) 与 标签 \(L\)¶

当一个街区的尽头没有跳跃 例外,或 陷阱 中止,然后执行以下步骤。

  1. 弹 值 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^\ast\) 从顶部 栈.

  2. 主张:因 验证,则 标签 \(L\) 现在在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出 标签 从 栈.

  4. 推开 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^\ast\) 回到原点 栈.

  5. 跳转到结束后的位置 结构化 控制指令 与《公约》 标签 \(L\).

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{n}}{\{ {{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast} \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^\ast} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

说明

此语义也适用于: 指令 a 包含的序列 \(\mathsf{loop}\) 指令。 。 。 因此, 执行 除非明确执行后向分支。

例外处理¶

以下辅助规则定义了进出的语义 \(\mathsf{try\_table}\) 块。

输入 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\) 与 标签 \(L\) 和例外处理器 \(H\)¶

  1. 推开 \(H\) 页:1 栈.

  2. 推开 \(L\) 打开 栈.

  3. 跳转到开始 指令 顺序 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\).

说明

加入例外不需要正式的削减规则 处理器 因为它是一个 管理指令 关于 \(\mathsf{try\_table}\) 指令 减少为直接。

退出例外处理器¶

当一个结束 \(\mathsf{try\_table}\) 未跳过即到达块, 例外,或 陷阱,然后采取以下步骤。

  1. 让 \(m\) 编号 值 在顶部 栈.

  2. 弹出 值 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^m\) 从 栈.

  3. 主张:因 验证,处理器和一个 标签 现在在顶部 栈.

  4. 弹出 标签 从 栈.

  5. 弹出处理器 \(H\) 从 栈.

  6. 推开 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^m\) 回到原点 栈.

  7. 跳转到结束后的位置 管理指令 与处理器相关联 \(H\).

函数调用¶

以下辅助规则界定了援引一项规则的语义。 函数实例 通过其中之一 电话 指令 然后从它返回。

援引 函数引用 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}func}}~a)\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 主张:因 验证, \(z.\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-store}{\mathsf{funcs}}[a]\) 已存在。

  3. 让 \(\mathit{fi}\) 成为 函数实例, \(z.\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-store}{\mathsf{funcs}}[a]\).

  4. 让 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{func}}~[t_1^n] \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\rightarrow} [t_2^m]\) 成为 复合类型 \(\href{../valid/conventions.html#aux-expand-deftype}{\mathrm{expand}}(\mathit{fi}.\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{type}})\).

  5. 让 \(\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-func}{\mathsf{func}}~x~(\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-local}{\mathit{local}}~t)^\ast~\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\) 成为 函数 \(\mathit{fi}.\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{code}}\).

  6. 主张:因 验证, \(n\) 值 在顶部 栈.

  7. 弹出 值 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^n\) 从 栈.

  8. 让 \(f\) 成为 栈帧 \(\{ \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{locals}}~\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^n~(\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-default}{\mathrm{default}}_t)^\ast, \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{module}}~\mathit{fi}.\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{module}} \}\).

  9. 推动激活 \(f\) 具有多样性 \(m\) 页:1 栈.

  10. 让 \(L\) 成为 标签 他们的分量是: \(m\) 并且其延续是函数的结束。

  11. 输入 联合国 指令 顺序 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}^\ast\) 与 标签 \(L\) 且无 值.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & z ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}func}}~a)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{call\_ref}}~y) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & z ; ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}}_{m}}{\{ f \}}~({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-label}{\mathsf{label}}}_{m}}{\{ \epsilon \}}~{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast})) & \\ &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad \quad \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} \mbox{if}~ z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{funcs}}{}[a] = {\mathit{fi}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{type}} \mathrel{\href{../valid/conventions.html#aux-expand-deftype}{\approx}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{func}}~{t_1^{n}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\rightarrow} {t_2^{m}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{code}} = \href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-func}{\mathsf{func}}~x~{(\href{../syntax/modules.html#syntax-local}{\mathsf{local}}~t)^\ast}~({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr}{\mathit{instr}}}^\ast}) \\ {\land}~ f = \{ \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{locals}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~{({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#aux-default}{\mathrm{default}}}}_{t})^\ast},\;\allowbreak \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{module}}~{\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{module}} \} \\ \end{array} } \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

对于不可违约 类型,则本规则未将相关地方初始化。

从函数返回¶

当一个函数的结束没有跳跃(包括通过) \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{return}}\)),或一个 例外 或 陷阱 中止,然后执行以下步骤。

  1. 让 \(F\) 成为 当前 栈帧.

  2. 让 \(n\) 成为激活 \(F\).

  3. 主张:因 验证,还有 \(n\) 值 在顶部 栈.

  4. 弹出结果 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^n\) 从 栈.

  5. 主张:因 验证,则 栈帧 \(F\) 现在在顶部 栈.

  6. 弹出 栈帧 从 栈.

  7. 推开 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}^n\) 回到原点 栈.

  8. 跳转到 指令 初约后.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & ({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-frame}{\mathsf{frame}}}_{n}}{\{ f \}}~{{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

主机函数¶

援引 宿主函数 有非决定性的行为。 它可以以下列方式终止: 陷阱,一个 例外,或定期返回。 然而,在后一种情况下,它必须消费并产生适当的数字,而且 类型 页:1 WebAssembly 值 编辑 栈, (中文). 根据其 函数类型.

A 宿主函数 也可以修改 存储。 。 。 然而,所有 存储 修改必须导致 扩展 原件编号 存储,即它们只必须修改可变内容,不得删除实例。 此外,结果是: 存储 必须是 无效,即它中的所有数据和代码都是井然有序的。

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & s ; f ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}func}}~a)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{call\_ref}}~y) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & {s'} ; f ; {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-result}{\mathit{result}}} & \\ &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad \quad \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} \mbox{if}~ (s ; f){.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{funcs}}{}[a] = {\mathit{fi}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{type}} \mathrel{\href{../valid/conventions.html#aux-expand-deftype}{\approx}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{func}}~{t_1^{n}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\rightarrow} {t_2^{m}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{code}} = {\mathit{hf}} \\ {\land}~ ({s'}, {\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-result}{\mathit{result}}}) \in {{\mathit{hf}}}{(s, {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}})} \\ \end{array} } \\ & s ; f ; {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}~(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}func}}~a)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{call\_ref}}~y) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & s ; f ; (\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}func}}~a)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-control}{\mathsf{call\_ref}}~y) & \\ &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad \quad \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} \mbox{if}~ (s ; f){.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{funcs}}{}[a] = {\mathit{fi}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{type}} \mathrel{\href{../valid/conventions.html#aux-expand-deftype}{\approx}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{func}}~{t_1^{n}} \href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\rightarrow} {t_2^{m}} \\ {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-funcinst}{\mathsf{code}} = {\mathit{hf}} \\ {\land}~ \bot \in {{\mathit{hf}}}{(s, {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}})} \\ \end{array} } \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

在这里, \({{\mathit{hf}}}{(s, {{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}})}\) 表示执行定义 执行 页:1 宿主函数 \({\mathit{hf}}\) 当前 存储 \(s\) 有参数 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}\)。 。 。 它产生一系列可能的结果,其中每个要素要么是一对经过修改的 存储 \({s'}\) (单位:千美元) 结果 或特殊价值 \(\bot\) 显示差异。 页:1 宿主函数 如果至少有一个参数的结果不是单数,则非决定性。

对于a WebAssembly 执行 声音 在有主办职能的情况下, 每个 东道主 函数实例 必须是 无效, (中文). 这意味着它遵守适当的前后条件: A项下 无效 存储 \(s\)参数 \({{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}^{n}}\) 匹配 参数 类型 \({t_1^{n}}\), (中文). 执行 宿主函数 必须产生一套非空的、可能的结果,每种结果要么是分歧,要么是由有效的结果构成。 存储 \({s'}\) 这是一个 扩展 页:1 \(s\) 和结果 匹配 属性返回 类型 \({t_2^{m}}\)。 。 。 所有这些概念在《宪法》中都有明确规定。 附 录.

说明

A 宿主函数 可以调回 WebAssembly 由 引用 函数 导出 从a 模块。 。 。 然而,任何这种呼吁的效果都包含在允许非决定性行为之中。 宿主函数.

说明

那个 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}grow}}\) 指令 是非决定性的。 它要么成功, 返回旧的桌子大小 \(\mathit{sz}\), (中文). 或失败,返回 \({-1}\)。 。 。 失败 必须 如果引用 表实例 已定义的最大大小将超过。 然而,失败 能够 其他情况也是如此。 实际上,选择取决于 资源 备查 嵌入器.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}fill}}~x\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 从 栈.

  4. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  5. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 从 栈.

  6. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \({\mathit{at}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  7. 弹出值 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathit{numtype}}}_0{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 从 栈.

  8. 若为 \(i + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{tables}}{}[x]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-tableinst}{\mathsf{refs}}|}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

  9. 若为 \(n = 0\),则:

    1. 什么都别做。

  10. 否则:

    1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 页:1 栈.

    2. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 页:1 栈.

    3. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}set}}~x)\).

    4. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i + 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    5. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 页:1 栈.

    6. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    7. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}fill}}~x)\).

      2. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 页:1 栈.

    2. 否则:

      1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1 + n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      2. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2 + n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      3. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}get}}~x_2)\).

      4. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}set}}~x_1)\).

      5. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1)\) 页:1 栈.

      6. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 页:1 栈.

    3. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    4. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-table}{\mathsf{table{.}copy}}~x_1~x_2)\).

内存指令¶

说明

那个 对齐 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-memarg}{\mathit{memarg}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{align}}\) 在负载和 存储 指令 不影响语义。 这是一个暗示,抵消 \(\mathit{ea}\) 访问内存是为了满足属性 \(\mathit{ea} \mathbin{\mathrm{mod}} 2^{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-memarg}{\mathit{memarg}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{align}}} = 0\). A WebAssembly 执行可以使用这一提示来优化预期用途。 侵犯该财产的不结盟准入仍然被允许,无论说明如何,都必须取得成功。 然而,在某些硬件上,可能要慢得多。

\({{\mathit{nt}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{load}}}{{{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-loadop}{\mathit{loadop}}}^?}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 从 栈.

  4. 若为 \({{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-loadop}{\mathit{loadop}}}^?}\) 未定义,则:

    1. 若为 \(i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{offset}} + {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-meminst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|}\),则:

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  4. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 页:1 栈.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}grow}}~x\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 从 栈.

  4. 要么:

    1. 让 \({\mathit{mi}}\) 成为 内存实例 \({\href{../exec/modules.html#grow-mem}{\mathrm{growmem}}}(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x], n)\).

    2. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~{|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-meminst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|} / (64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}}))\) 页:1 栈.

    3. 替换 \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x]\) 与 \({\mathit{mi}}\).

  5. 或曰:

    1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~{{{{\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-signed}{\mathrm{signed}}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})})\) 页:1 栈.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}} & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}grow}}~x) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & z{}[{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x] = {\mathit{mi}}] ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~{|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-meminst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|} / 64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}}) & \\ &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{mi}} = {\href{../exec/modules.html#grow-mem}{\mathrm{growmem}}}(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x], n) } \\ & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)~(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}grow}}~x) & \href{../exec/conventions.html#exec-notation}{\hookrightarrow} & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~{{{{\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-signed}{\mathrm{signed}}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})}) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

说明

那个 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}grow}}\) 指令 是非决定性的。 它要么成功, 返回旧的内存大小 \(\mathit{sz}\), (中文). 或失败,返回 \({-1}\)。 。 。 失败 必须 如果引用 内存实例 已定义的最大大小将超过。 然而,失败 能够 其他情况也是如此。 实际上,选择取决于 资源 备查 嵌入器.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}fill}}~x\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 从 栈.

  4. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  5. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 从 栈.

  6. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \({\mathit{at}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  7. 弹出值 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathit{numtype}}}_0{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 从 栈.

  8. 若为 \(i + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-meminst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

  9. 若为 \(n = 0\),则:

    1. 什么都别做。

  10. 否则:

    1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 页:1 栈.

    2. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 页:1 栈.

    3. 执行 指令 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{store}}}{8}~x)\).

    4. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i + 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    5. 按下这个值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 页:1 栈.

    6. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}copy}}~x_1~x_2\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 从 栈.

  4. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  5. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 从 栈.

  6. 表示: 应付 验证, a 数字值 是在顶部 栈.

  7. 弹出值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1)\) 从 栈.

  8. 若为 \(i_1 + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{mems}}{}[x_1]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-meminst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

    1. 陷阱.

  10. 若为 \(n = 0\),则:

    1. 什么都别做。

  11. 否则:

    1. 若为 \(i_1 \leq i_2\),则:

      1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1)\) 页:1 栈.

      2. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 页:1 栈.

      3. 执行 指令 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{load}}}{{8}{\mathsf{\_}}{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-sx}{\mathsf{u}}}}~x_2)\).

      4. 执行 指令 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{store}}}{8}~x_1)\).

      5. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1 + 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      6. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2 + 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    2. 否则:

      1. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1 + n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      2. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2 + n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      4. 执行 指令 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{store}}}{8}~x_1)\).

      5. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_1)\) 页:1 栈.

      6. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 页:1 栈.

    3. 按下这个值 \(({\mathit{at}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

    4. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-memory}{\mathsf{memory{.}copy}}~x_1~x_2)\).

    1. 让 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a_1)\) 被调整结构 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}'}\).

        1. 表示: 应付 验证,则 扩展 页:1 \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{types}}{}[x_2]\) 有点 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{array}}~{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-fieldtype}{\mathit{fieldtype}}}\).

          3. 按下这个值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i_2)\) 页:1 栈.

\(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}init\_data}}~x~y\)¶

  1. 让 \(z\) 为当前状态。

  2. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  3. 弹出值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n)\) 从 栈.

  4. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  5. 弹出值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~j)\) 从 栈.

  6. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值 数字类型 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}\) 是在顶部 栈.

  7. 弹出值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 从 栈.

  8. 表示: 应付 验证,一个值位于 栈.

  9. 弹出值 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 从 栈.

  10. 若为 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}} = \href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}null}}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

  11. 表示: 应付 验证, \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\) 有点 \(\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~{\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-arrayaddr}{\mathit{arrayaddr}}}\).

  12. 让 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) 被调整结构 \({\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-val}{\mathit{val}}}\).

  13. 若为 \(a < {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{arrays}}|}\) 和 \(i + n > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{arrays}}{}[a]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-arrayinst}{\mathsf{fields}}|}\),则:

    1. 陷阱.

  14. 如果 扩展 页:1 \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{types}}{}[x]\) 有点 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{array}}~{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-fieldtype}{\mathit{fieldtype}}}\),则:

    1. 让 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-comptype}{\mathsf{array}}~{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-fieldtype}{\mathit{fieldtype}}}_0)\) 将改变结构 扩展 页:1 \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{types}}{}[x]\).

    2. 让 \(({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-mut}{\mathsf{mut}}^?}~{\mathit{zt}})\) 被调整结构 \({\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-fieldtype}{\mathit{fieldtype}}}_0\).

    3. 若为 \(j + n \cdot {|{\mathit{zt}}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{datas}}{}[y]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-datainst}{\mathsf{bytes}}|}\),则:

      1. 陷阱.

    4. 若为 \(n = 0\),则:

      1. 什么都别做。

    5. 否则:

      1. 让 \(c\) 的结果 \({{\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-bytes}{\mathrm{bytes}}}}_{{\mathit{zt}}}(c)\) \(=\) \(z{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-state}{\mathsf{datas}}{}[y]{.}\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-datainst}{\mathsf{bytes}}{}[j : {|{\mathit{zt}}|} / 8]\).

      2. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

      3. 按下这个值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i)\) 页:1 栈.

      4. 按下这个值 \({\href{../syntax/types.html#aux-unpack}{\mathrm{unpack}}}({\mathit{zt}}){.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~{{\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-unpacknum}{\mathrm{unpack}}}}_{{\mathit{zt}}}(c)\) 页:1 栈.

      5. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}set}}~x)\).

      6. 按下这个值 \((\href{../exec/runtime.html#syntax-ref}{\mathsf{ref{.}array}}~a)\) 页:1 栈.

      7. 按下这个值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~i + 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      8. 按下这个值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~j + {|{\mathit{zt}}|} / 8)\) 页:1 栈.

      9. 按下这个值 \((\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}{.}\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{const}}~n - 1)\) 页:1 栈.

      10. 执行 指令 \((\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-array}{\mathsf{array{.}init\_data}}~x~y)\).

  15. 否则,如果 \(n = 0\),则:

    1. 什么都别做。

数值指令¶

数值指令 按通用术语定义。 数字运算符。 。 。 绘制 数值指令 对其基本操作者的定义如下:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(i_1,\dots,i_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#int-ops}{\mathrm{i}\mathit{op}}_N(i_1,\dots,i_k) \\ \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(z_1,\dots,z_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#float-ops}{\mathrm{f}\mathit{op}}_N(z_1,\dots,z_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

还有为了 转换操作符:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-cvtop}{\mathit{cvtop}}^{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-sx}{\mathit{sx}}^?}_{t_1,t_2}(c) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#convert-ops}{\mathit{cvtop}}^{\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-sx}{\mathit{sx}}^?}_{|t_1|,|t_2|}(c) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

如果基础操作员为部分操作,则相应的操作员 指令 将 陷阱 当结果未定义时。 如果基础操作者不是决定性的,因为他们可能返回多种可能的操作者之一 纳恩 值,对应的也是 指令.

说明

例如,结果 指令 \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}\) 用于操作 \(i_1, i_2\) 引用 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}}(i_1, i_2)\), (中文). 绘制到通用 \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#op-iadd}{\mathrm{iadd}}_{32}(i_1, i_2)\) 通过上述定义。 同样, \(\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle64}}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{trunc}}\mathsf{\_}\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f\scriptstyle32}}\mathsf{\_s}\) 适用于 \(z\) 引用 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{trunc}}^{\mathsf{s}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{f\scriptstyle32}},\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle64}}}(z)\), (中文). 绘制到通用 \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#op-trunc}{\mathrm{trunc}^{\mathsf{s}}}_{32,64}(z)\).

向量指令¶

向量指令 以 整数 相应位宽的操作。

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll@{\qquad}l} \mathit{op}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-vectype}{\mathsf{v}\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}(i_1,\dots,i_k) &=& \href{../Step_pure/numerics.html#int-ops}{\mathrm{i}\mathit{op}}_N(i_1,\dots,i_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

其他情况 向量指令 定义如下: 数字运算符 按给定的航道 形状.

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{llll} \mathit{op}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1,\dots,n_k) &=& \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(\href{../Step_pure/instructions.html#exec-instr-numeric}{\mathit{op}}_t(i_1,\dots,i_k)^\ast) & \qquad(\mathrel{\mbox{if}} i_1^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1) \land \dots \land i_k^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_k) \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

说明

例如,结果 指令 \(\mathsf{i32x4}.\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}\) 用于操作 \(v_1, v_2\) 引用 \(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_1, v_2)\),哪个地图 \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(\href{../syntax/instructions.html#syntax-instr-numeric}{\mathsf{add}}_{\href{../syntax/types.html#syntax-numtype}{\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}}}(i_1, i_2)^\ast)\), (中文). 地点 \(i_1^\ast\) 和 \(i_2^\ast\) 是引用时产生的序列 \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_1)\) 和 \(\href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{\mathsf{i32x4}}(v_2)\) 页:1

对于非决定性运算符,这一定义被概括为设置:

\[\begin{split}\begin{array}{lll} \mathit{op}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1,\dots,n_k) &=& \{ \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}^{-1}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(i^\ast) ~|~ i^\ast \in {\Large\times}(\href{../Step_pure/instructions.html#exec-instr-numeric}{\mathit{op}}_t(i_1,\dots,i_k)^\ast) \land i_1^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_1) \land \dots \land i_k^\ast = \href{../exec/numerics.html#aux-lanes}{\mathrm{lanes}}_{t\mathsf{x}N}(n_k) \} \\ \end{array}\end{split}\]

地点 \({\Large\times} \{x^\ast\}^N\) 转换序列 \(N\) 成套资源 值 进入一组序列 \(N\) 值 通过计算成套产品:

\[\begin{array}{lll} {\Large\times} (S_1 \dots S_N) &=& \{ x_1 \dots x_N ~|~ x_1 \in S_1 \land \dots \land x_N \in S_N \} \end{array}\]

剩下的矢量运算符使用 个别定义.
